INDEPENDENT DOM EVIDENCE: probe groups.G9.iv_costSplit — 10 occurrences across overview/costs/analytics of 'API-billed $61.85', 'Plan-included $125.57', '$187.42 spent of $300.00 spending limit · warn at 80%', with 61.85 + 125.57 = 187.42 exactly; groups.G8 recorded 'cost per child = $0.00 · plan included' (a zero rendered WITH its settlement basis); groups.G9.i_zeroForUnknown found 8 zero renderings app-wide and 0 of them in a row also marked unknown/unavailable.
decisions.note: Three gaps against 'fixed'. (1) There is no reference API price at all — referenceApiPriceMicro and catalogPrice return 0 hits — so 'never imply a plan-included call was billed at catalog API price' is satisfied vacuously by omission rather than by separating the two figures. (2) The settlement enum is short two values: extra_balance and no_charge_observed return 0 hits, and the concept's own reports/impact-register.json unresolved_questions[2] concedes 'billingRoute values extra_balance / no_charge_observed legal but not yet demonstrated by a fixture'. (3) The exact user-facing string 'Included with your plan' does not exist; the rendered wording is 'Plan-included' (u11-widgets.js:316) and 'plan included' (u11-context.js:39). Also note the concept splits the packet's single 'settlement' concept across two fields (billingRoute + settlement), so a key-by-key enum match will read as a miss even though the semantics are covered.

decisions.title: Usage telemetry is optional readiness
decisions.evidence: The independence case is in the data and reaches the UI. u11-data.js:181 meter:oc-go-monthly vs 'unavailable', conf 'medium', note 'Provider ready · Usage details unavailable', estimate{usedPct 63, basis 'PM history · last 7 days', conf 'medium'} — sitting on prod:oc-go-plan whose connection conn:opencode-go is state 'ready' (:93), i.e. a ready provider with no usage telemetry. Renderer u11-widgets.js:270-274 emits '<meter label> · Provider data unavailable · PM estimate 63% · medium confidence' for any non-top meter with vs 'unavailable' + estimate; I verified reachability by construction — prod:oc-go-plan ranks 5th of 27 products by top-meter usedPct (meter:oc-go-5h at 72%) and renderPlans renders rows.slice(0, topn=5) at default config (u11-widgets.js:245-247), with meter:oc-go-monthly correctly a non-top meter. Adjacent unknown-not-zero renderings: u11-widgets.js:291 and u11-context.js:122,133 render 'limit not exposed'; u11-data.js:195 meter:local-ollama vs 'not_exposed' note 'Local models expose no usage API — nothing to read, different from reading zero'; :177 and :184 'limit not exposed' for kimi-pool / zai-legacy-req. Readiness is never computed from telemetry — connection.state and account.state are independent literals with no dependency on any meter (u11-data.js:62-107). Source ranking exists partially as sourceClass provider_reported / cli_reported / pm_observed / local_estimated / unknown plus receiptRef, rendered in the inspector meta line (u11-rundetail.js:260-263) and aggregated in the Source authority card (u11-widgets.js:926-932). Runtime corroboration for the honesty half: probe groups.G9.i_zeroForUnknown = 8 zero renderings app-wide, 0 in a row carrying an unknown/unavailable marker.
decisions.note: Gaps. (1) The exact user-facing string 'Provider ready · Usage details unavailable' never reaches the DOM: renderPlans appends m.note only when vs === 'unknown' (u11-widgets.js:266-267), and the vs === 'unavailable' branch (:270-274) emits its own wording, so that note is data-only. (2) Cookie telemetry is entirely absent — 'cookie' and 'experimental' return 0 hits across the u11 bundle and _shared/usage-data.js — so 'cookie telemetry stays optional, experimental, scoped, revocable' is unrepresented rather than violated; both ABSENT keys pass vacuously. (3) No header-based source in the sourceClass vocabulary, and no explicit preference ordering among official API / CLI / header / receipt. (4) Evidence limit: the independent probe never text-sampled the plans room — 'PM estimate' and 'Provider ready' both return 0 hits in independent-probe-results.json — so the rendered estimate line rests on renderer+data reachability plus the concept's own u11-verify.mjs:391 DOM regex and verify-shots/plans-estimate.png. (5) Fragile at small sizes: at sizeKey 'S' topn drops to 3 (u11-widgets.js:245), which would push prod:oc-go-plan out of the rendered set and hide the whole telemetry-unavailable case.
